lines.text: Asaph calls for singing, the tambourine, harp and lyre, and the ram's horn at the New Moon.
God made the feast a statute for Israel, a testimony for Joseph when he went out over Egypt.
God rescued His people when they called in distress, answered from the cloud of thunder, and tested them at Massah.
God forbids a strange god, but Israel would not listen, so He gave them up to their stubborn hearts.
If Israel followed Him, God would subdue their enemies and feed them the finest barley, with honey from the rock.
